text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Tips for Reading the Weather."
...It couldn't hurt to know, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"There's so much knowledge applicable to racing...
Just memorizing it all is quite an ordeal."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Post-race Hachimi: extra firm, extra rich, extra large! Gotta jot that down!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You never know what might serve as a hint.
I'll make sure to remember this, too—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It'll be time for training soon.
There is no time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, having pushed herself far too hard, Air Messiah ended up plagued by a headache..."
